#### Task 4 – Generator Rentals – As needed

The City prefers Contractor that can provide rental generators as needed during the duration of the 
contract. Need will be determined by the City. Contractor shall provide price list per fiscal year. 
Weekly rates shall include a fully operational generator meeting the specified kilowatt capacity, 
delivery, installation, maintenance, and pickup.

#### Task 3 - On-Call Emergency and Non-Emergency Repairs

Time and material costs associated with emergency/after-hours and non-emergency generator repair 
services. The City shall not be directly invoiced for the following:

• Travel and/or transportation of workers;

• Parts and materials acquisition including sales tax. freight, handling, and delivery; and
• Movement of Contractor owned or rented equipment.

For purposes of the agreement, these are considered overhead, and the costs shall be included in the fixed 
hourly labor rates on this page. All invoices to the City for on-call emergency and non-emergency repair 
services must include a breakdown of number of hours for all fixed rates charged and the original cost and 
mark up price for all parts and materials charged. The City shall reserve the right to request backup 
documentation for the contractor’s original cost on parts and materials.
